steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Wash path prerequisites
steps.body: Inspect sump, RIF filter, and spray arms. Run Service Diagnostics wash-motor interval first.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect sump, RIF filter, and spray arms. Run Service Diagnostics wash-motor interval first.

steps.title: Disconnect P5
steps.body: Power off. Remove toe and outer door panels. Unplug P5 from control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Remove toe and outer door panels. Unplug P5 from control.

steps.title: VSM wash motor — P5 pins 1 & 2
steps.body: Ohms P5-1 to P5-2. KDTM404 A-SYNCH variable-speed wash (800 W wet / 500 W dry). Filtration VSM spec 16–18 Ω applies; SSM models use 10–15 Ω on same pins.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Ohms P5-1 to P5-2. KDTM404 A-SYNCH variable-speed wash (800 W wet / 500 W dry). Filtration VSM spec 16–18 Ω applies; SSM models use 10–15 Ω on same pins.

steps.title: Reassemble and run Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Reconnect P5. Reassemble panels. Restore power and run Service Diagnostics to verify wash motor operation.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect P5. Reassemble panels. Restore power and run Service Diagnostics to verify wash motor operation.

steps.title: Replace wash motor
steps.body: Replace variable-speed wash motor if winding failed (F7E2).
steps.oemOutcome: Replace variable-speed wash motor if winding failed (F7E2).

steps.title: VSM wash motor verified
steps.body: VSM wash motor verified. No AC bench run test — motor uses DC drive from control.
steps.oemOutcome: VSM wash motor verified. No AC bench run test — motor uses DC drive from control.
